integrity: The proof combines an exact analytic small-guild invariance argument, exhaustive finite connected incidence-matrix enumeration, and exact integer partition optimization. A standalone standard-library program reproduces the enumeration and independently checks all witness partitions. No independent mathematical audit or external certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for connected simple binary bipartite interaction networks and for one connected-output degree-preserving checkerboard swap.

The nestedness score is standard normalized NODF with zero contributions for equal-degree pairs; modularity is the global maximum of ordinary Newman-Girvan modularity, not Barber bipartite modularity.
The exhaustive exclusion checks networks with at most seven total species and the explicit eight-species witness; no larger-network census or ecological stability prediction is claimed.
Novelty may have an overlooked exact equivalent under different graph network terminology; some recent supplements were unavailable for complete inspection.
title: Eight species are sharp for simultaneous nestedness and modularity improvement under a degree-preserving swap
